activity.overview: Decompose fractions into sums, add on a number line, and see multiplication as repeated addition of a fraction.

problems.prompt: Write 4/5 as a sum of unit fractions (fractions with a numerator of 1).
Write 5/6 as a sum of fractions in two different ways.
Draw a number line from 0 to 1 divided into eighths. Start at 3/8 and jump forward 2/8. Where do you land? Write the equation.
Write 3 × 1/4 as an addition equation, then find the answer.
Write 5/3 as a whole number times 1/3. Then write 5/3 as a mixed number.

activity.subject: mathematics
activity.title: Breaking Fractions Apart
